paragraphs: R. Yehudah HaGazzar, chapter R. Eliezer [פר״א; apparently R. Eliezer DeMilah, cited next]; he was a circumciser in our holy Rabbi's time. The chapter “Rabbi Eliezer of circumcision,” Shabbat 130b: R. Oshaya said, “I asked R. Yehudah HaGazzar”; so too the Jerusalem Talmud. In R. Yaakov bar Acha's name: Jerusalem Rosh Hashanah, end of chapter 3. [The checked text names Rabbi Acha here.] R. Yaakov bar Acha and R. Simon, in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name: there, Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 7. [At 1:5:7 in the checked edition, Yehudah Gazori transmits alongside Yaakov bar Acha and Simon.]
